command: Human ATG14 localizes to phagocytic vesicles and regulates gene expression at a post-transcriptional level. Adjudicate these separately. For localization, trace the mouse Q8CDJ3 IDA source PMID:22493499 and distinguish exclusion from one SLAMF1/VPS34/UVRAG interaction from exclusion from every phagosome. For GO:0010608, read the actual definition and PMID:23878393 protein-versus-transcript and BECN1-complex-stability experiments; determine whether abundance/stability control meets the term or an RNA/translation step is required. Do not dispute the already directly demonstrated ATG14 mitophagy/complex-stability roles or manufacture negative experiments from missing panels.
